Bring your own drawing materials

We hang out and draw in each other's company. Our gatherings are relaxed and guided by the host — drop by, stay as long as you wish, draw with us.

Drawing here is free subject — draw whatever you like. If you'd rather have a bit of direction, a creative challenge is proposed each week, with a different theme to explore. Following it is entirely your choice.

Where To Find Us

Meet at the garden of the Centro de Arte Moderna Gulbenkian (CAM) — enter from Rua Marquês Sá da Bandeira.

São Sebastião Praça de Espanha
Look for the group near the garden entrance closest to Rua Marquês Sá da Bandeira

FAQ

Q. Do I need to register?

No. Just show up — no sign-up, no ticket, no RSVP required.

Q. Is it really free?

Yes, completely free. The only entrance is the Gulbenkian garden, which is open and free to the public.

Q. Do I need experience to join?

Not at all. Beginners and professionals draw side by side — there's no teaching or critique, just shared time to create.

Q. Is there a theme to follow?

It's up to you. Drawing is free subject, but each week a creative challenge is proposed for anyone who wants a bit of direction.

Q. What should I bring?

Your own materials — pencils, pens, watercolor, sketchbook, or even a tablet. A small foldable chair is welcome too, just in case.

Q. What if it rains?

We move to a covered spot nearby. Check @lisbon_creative_drawing on the morning of the meeting for updates.

Q. Can I come alone?

Absolutely — most people do. It's a friendly, easy way to meet other creatives in Lisbon.

Q. Is it for kids too?

Yes — all ages are welcome, families included.
